name: DocVQA
description: A dataset of manually annotated questions and answers about document images, with 50,000 questions over approximately 12,000 images.
citation: Mathew, Minesh, Dimosthenis Karatzas, and C. V. Jawahar. DocVQA: A Dataset for VQA on Document Images. WACV 2021. https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.00398
